title: Atal Setu · Shivaji Nagar and the land transition
visualBrief: The two mapped carriageways have separate box girders and piers, striped barriers and median lamps. The channel sections preserve the longer steel spans.
nativeAxes: +X follows the section chord, +Y is up, +Z is the right side of +X in the placement frame.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry from ordinary photographs and OpenStreetMap carriageways via Protomaps PMTiles, with Terrarium terrain samples.
materialMethod: Shared board-formed concrete, plain concrete and painted metal with metric UVs and vertex tints.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The section uses absolute deck and footing heights fitted to standard Terrarium samples.
geographicProposal.notes: Placement follows the authored bounds and paired map axes. Deck elevations, pier stations and steel-span extents are visual estimates.

reviewStatus: Current visual and placement acceptance is recorded separately.
limitations: The two mapped carriageways and tagged ramp alignments determine the plan. The surface-road interval remains terrain-rendered.

Steel-span zones and approximate deck grades use the published preparatory study, exterior photographs and standard terrain. Individual as-built pier stations and engineering clearances are estimates.
